name: 500 words left
source:
Come closer, curious jackal, listen to my last breaths.
You think you, an eternal being, a goddess of death, can help me? Well then, be a loyal companion, figure out how I should live my life.

[From [url=https://amordochka.itch.io/500-words-left]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
靠近点，好奇的豺狼，听听我最后的呼吸。
你认为你，一个永恒的存在，死亡女神，可以帮助我吗？那么，做一个忠诚的伴侣，弄清楚我应该如何度过我的生活。

[来自[url=https://amordochka.itch.io/500-words-left]itch.io[/url]]
